description: How the backend turns classified findings, analyzer health and coverage facts into one authoritative managed-CI decision. Finding classification itself is finding-policy-<version>.json. The runner's producer_diagnostics and coverage.required_analyzers are never inputs.

binding_policy.rule: A binding may add required analyzers; it can never remove the minimum. The snapshot in force at acceptance is the one evaluated.

provenance_rules: Every finding's analyzer_id names an entry of manifest.analyzers; otherwise the submission is invalid_evidence (finding_analyzer_unreported).
Every analyzer's finding_count equals the number of findings naming it; otherwise the submission is invalid_evidence (analyzer_finding_count_mismatch).
coverage.observed_analyzers is a subset of manifest.analyzers; otherwise the submission is invalid_evidence (observed_analyzer_unreported).

coverage.required_analyzer_invariant: A required analyzer is satisfied ONLY when its manifest.analyzers entry has status completed AND its id appears in coverage.observed_analyzers. Absence and every other status (failed, skipped, not_applicable, or any status a later contract adds) produce an incomplete coverage result. For the pilot an SCA analyzer that finds no supported manifest completes successfully with zero findings; not_applicable cannot satisfy a required analyzer.

required_analyzer_outcomes.condition: status completed and present in coverage.observed_analyzers
status skipped with any other reason_code
status completed but absent from coverage.observed_analyzers

coverage.order: required analyzers in ascending id order, then coverage.gaps in submitted order, then optional analyzers in submitted order; each reason code is kept at its first occurrence
coverage.coverage_state: incomplete when any coverage reason code is present, otherwise complete

unclassifiable_findings.rule: An unclassifiable finding is counted in no status bucket. Its reason code joins the decision's reason codes.

reason_codes: [lead_reason_code, if any] + coverage reason codes + unclassifiable reason codes, each kept at its first occurrence
